entries.reason: Diffed selectors-0.26.0 against selectors-0.38.0 (tree.rs, context.rs, matching.rs, parser.rs, bloom.rs, attr.rs, visitor.rs, lib.rs) and cssparser-0.34.0 against cssparser-0.37.0. The Element trait is byte-for-byte the same method set, SelectorImpl bounds, Parser trait hooks (parse_has / parse_is_and_where / parse_host / parse_slotted / parse_non_ts_pseudo_class), NonTSPseudoClass, PseudoElement (only new default methods), MatchingContext::new(6 args), scope_element / current_host fields, SelectorCaches, matches_selector / matches_selector_list, AncestorHashes::new, SelectorList::parse, Component variants and fields used by subject_keys (LocalName.lower_name, AttributeInNoNamespaceExists.local_name_lower, AttributeOther.local_name_lower, Is, Where, Root, Combinator) are all unchanged. The ONE shape change used by obscura-dom: `Selector::matches_featureless_host_selector_or_pseudo_element() -> FeaturelessHostMatches` (bitflags FOR_HOST / FOR_SCOPE) was replaced by `Selector::matches_featureless_host(scope_matches_featureless_host: bool) -> MatchesFeaturelessHost` (Yes/Only/Never, `.may_match()`). CompiledSelector::matches_featureless_host in crates/web/obscura-dom/src/selector.rs now calls `self.sel.matches_featureless_host(false).may_match()` (false = a bare :scope does not qualify, the old FOR_HOST-only meaning). cssparser: obscura only uses ParserInput/Parser/Token/ParseError/ParseErrorKind/SourceLocation/CowRcStr/ToCss/serialize_string, all unchanged between 0.34 and 0.37 (only var_or_env_functions renamed to arbitrary_substitution_functions, not used). cssparser 0.37 default features (fast_match_byte, fast_match_color) resolve to cssparser-macros 0.7.1 / phf 0.13.1, already in the lock. entries.source: crates/web/obscura-render/Cargo.toml: ureq = { version = "2.9", default-features = false, features = ["tls"], optional = true }
entries.target: ureq = { workspace = true, optional = true } (root pin: ureq = { version = "3", default-features = false, features = ["rustls"] }; Cargo.lock: ureq 3.3.0, already used by aphrody-embed)
entries.reason: HTTP client decision. best-stack-2026 picks reqwest 0.13 (rustls) and rejects surf/isahc/curl; ureq is not on the reject list. For this call site reqwest was NOT chosen: obscura-render is a deliberately runtime-free layout/paint crate whose image fetch (http_get_bytes) is a blocking call that can run on tokio worker threads when the CDP/JS layer drives a screenshot; reqwest::blocking panics when its client is built inside an async runtime (reqwest-0.13.5 blocking/client.rs ClientBuilder::build: 'This method panics if called from within an async runtime') and async reqwest would force a runtime dependency into the crate. ureq 3 is sync, already in the lock and already a root [workspace.dependencies] pin, so no new pin/package. TLS stays rustls + ring + webpki-roots: ureq 2 `tls` built its own ClientConfig with rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider(); ureq 3 `rustls` feature = rustls + ring + webpki-roots and picks the provider TlsConfig -> process default (CryptoProvider::get_default(), which the apps install as ring, cf. obscura-net/src/lib.rs) -> ring. Only difference: a process that installed a NON-ring default provider first would now make this client use it. Behaviour pins in image_agent(): timeout_global(10 s) (was .timeout), max_redirects(5) (ureq 2 default; ureq 3 default is 10), proxy(None) (ureq 2 ignored env proxies without `proxy-from-env`; ureq 3 reads them by default), same User-Agent, per-request Accept header. API port in crates/web/obscura-render/src/paint.rs: AgentBuilder -> Agent::config_builder().. .build() + Agent::new_with_config; `.set` -> `.header`; `resp.into_reader()` -> `resp.into_body().into_reader()` (unlimited, like ureq 2; the 10 MB limit only applies to read_to_vec/read_to_string); `Error::Status(code,_)` -> `Error::StatusCode(code)`; `Error::Transport(_)` -> any other error (retry/backoff logic identical); the URL is normalised through `url::Url` before the request because ureq 3 builds an http::Uri that rejects spaces/non-ASCII (ureq 2 used url::Url). STATUS: ported. Lead may overrule the HTTP client choice; the alternative is reqwest::blocking on a dedicated thread (bigger change).

entries.source: shared root pins: [workspace.dependencies] sha2 = "0.10.9", sha1 = "0.10.7", aes = "0.8.4", aes-gcm = "0.10", getrandom = "0.2"
entries.reason: NOT bumped (shared with other domains), and obscura-js does not use them (own version strings), so obscura-js does not add a duplicate: the new generation (digest 0.11 / cipher 0.5 / aead 0.6 / hybrid-array / getrandom 0.4) is already in the lock. But the OLD versions stay in Cargo.lock until a coordinated bump AND third-party moves: (1) sha2 0.10 / digest 0.10 / generic-array 0.14 stay for ed25519-dalek 2.2, p256, p384, jsonwebtoken 10.4 (octocrab), tauri-codegen, tauri-runtime-cef, termwiz, wezterm-blob-leases, rookie-cookies; (2) aes 0.8 / cbc 0.1 / pbkdf2 0.12 / sha1 0.10 / sha2 0.10 / getrandom 0.2 also stay for rookie-cookies 0.6.0 (root pin `=0.6.0`, only used by aphrody-web-chromium) ; sha1 0.10 also for tungstenite; getrandom 0.2 also for ring, rand_core 0.6, octocrab, grass; (3) hmac 0.12 / hkdf 0.12 also for jsonwebtoken / elliptic-curve. Realistic lock reduction from a coordinated workspace bump: only aes-gcm 0.10 + aead 0.5 + ghash 0.5 + polyval 0.6 + universal-hash 0.5 + opaque-debug + ctr 0.9 (needs aphrody-base, aphrody-secrets, aphrody-backend to move; ctr 0.9 and aes-gcm 0.10 have no other users than obscura-js and those 3 crates). Cross-domain call-site estimate for that bump (outside obscura): sha2 -> 15 workspace crates / 29 files mention Sha256/Sha1, but only 7 sites break on digest 0.11 because hybrid_array::Array has no LowerHex: `format!("{:x}", digest)` at apps/cli/src/ocr_cmd.rs:492, crates/ai/manga/src/pipeline.rs:314, crates/ai/marketplace/src/lib.rs:523, crates/koharu/koharu-library/src/project.rs:319, crates/os/winclean/src/dispatch.rs:1037, crates/os/winclean/tests/rust_surface.rs:42, crates/ui/identity/src/lib.rs:638 (fix: hex::encode(..)); every other `Sha256::digest`, `.finalize()`, `.as_slice()`, `.to_vec()`, `hex::encode(..)` keeps compiling. aes-gcm: aphrody-base (crates/os/base/src/lib.rs:151-153, benches), aphrody-secrets (crates/os/secrets/src/lib.rs:573-574, 602-603), aphrody-backend (benches/backend_bench.rs:98-109): ~9 `Key::<..>::from_slice` / `Nonce::from_slice` sites, deprecated in hybrid-array (a hard error under the workspace -D warnings lint set) -> `try_from` / `KeyInit::new_from_slice`. aphrody-re (crates/os/re/src/lib.rs:577-602 sha1, :806-890 aes CTR): cipher 0.5 trait renames, one function each. getrandom: aphrody-a2a-coord crates/os/a2a-coord/src/envelope.rs:5 and aphrody-a2a-client src/bin/a2a_duel_loop.rs:40 (`getrandom::getrandom` -> `getrandom::fill`), 2 sites. crates/os/drive/** (hkdf + sha2 Sha256) is outside the root graph in cargo-metadata-linux.json and was not counted. Total: ~30 edits in ~15 files across ai/os/ui/koharu/apps/cli, for ~7 lock packages removed.
